CTFd：填写该比赛实例的完整 /api/v1/scoreboard 地址；使用: CTFd: Enter the instance's full /api/v1/scoreboard URL. Expects success + data[] with pos, name, score, and bracket_name.
Custom JSON：接受 teams[] / data[] / standi: Custom JSON: Accepts teams[] / data[] / standings[], optionally submissions[]. See README for schema.
HKCERT 2026：单项成就得分 = 0.1 × M + 0.9 × M ÷: HKCERT 2026: Points per achievement = 0.1 × M + 0.9 × M ÷ [1 + (max(0, x−1) ÷ 11.92201)^1.206069]. x is the number of teams unlocking the achievement, and M is the maximum (usually 500). Round each achievement to two decimals before summing.
HKCERT 的 last_solve_at 只能表示最后解题时间；该接口不包含: HKCERT last_solve_at records only the last solve time; this endpoint does not include per-challenge submission history.
HKCTF 填 ID；CTFd 填队名或 account_id: For HKCTF enter team ID; for CTFd enter name or account_id
HKCTF2026：默认读取公开的 teams[]、team_id、displa: HKCTF2026: Reads public teams[], team_id, display_name, rank, score and last_solve_at. Endpoint can be changed; division position is derived.
HUD 显示的是排行榜接口返回的当前总分，不会把每次提交所记录的得分永久累加。随: The HUD shows the current total returned by the leaderboard API, not a permanent sum of submission points. As more teams solve the same achievement, the total may decrease.
● 位置调整中：点击穿透已临时关闭、位置锁定已临时解除。直接拖动 HUD 顶部标: ● Moving HUD: click-through and position lock are temporarily off. Drag the header, then select Finish moving.
● 当前：点击穿透{{click}} · 位置{{lock}}。移动位置会自动保: ● Current: click-through {{click}} · position {{lock}}. The position is saved for next launch.
仅向配置的端点发送无凭证 GET，每 120 秒检查一次。网址不可包含用户名、密: Sends unauthenticated GET only to the configured endpoint every 120 seconds. URLs must not embed usernames, passwords or tokens. Never commit private credentials.
全场序位* / 组别序位* 表示数据源没有提供相应官方名次，而是按返回列表推算。: Overall position* / division position* means the feed does not provide an official rank and the value is derived from the returned list. HKCERT provides overall rank; division position* is estimated from S/T/O/I team IDs, scores and available last-solve times. Unresolved ties are marked “tied” and are not official qualification ranks.
关闭同步：比赛时钟正常运行，不下载排行榜数据。: Sync off: The clock continues to work without fetching leaderboard data.
切换后立即生效，比赛和队伍资料不会被翻译或修改。: Changes apply immediately. Contest and team data is not translated or modified.
可创建多个比赛配置，分别设置时间轴和排名来源。所有资料保存在本机。: Create multiple contests, each with its own timeline and leaderboard source. All data stays on this Mac.
排行榜未找到队伍 ID 或名称: Team ID or name not found on leaderboard
提交记录 · 手动保存 / 可选 JSON 同步: Submissions · Local entries / optional JSON sync
无法读取排行榜（HTTP 状态异常或内容过大）: Unable to read leaderboard (HTTP error or response too large)
暂无提交。自动提交同步仅适用于提供授权 JSON 数据的比赛。: No submissions. Automatic sync only works for events that expose authorized JSON data.
更新时间为 HUD 在本机最后成功读取可用数据的时刻（按比赛时区显示），不等于比: Updated time is the last time this HUD successfully read valid data (in the event time zone), not the time the competition server last changed the leaderboard. Δ requires two comparable valid snapshots.
最后阶段从最后一个非结束节点开始；若只有开始和结束两个节点，则比赛开始后进入最后: The final phase begins at the last non-end milestone. If there are only start and end milestones, it begins at the start. This affects display only, not alerts.
榜单及其变化（仅数据有效时显示）: Leaderboard and changes (when data is available)
每个阶段均提醒（否则只提醒比赛结束）: Alert on every milestone (otherwise event end only)
每个项目单独控制。纯净模式仍隐藏完整模式的顶部标题与状态栏；调整位置时始终显示临: Each element can be controlled separately. Clean mode hides the full-mode header and status bar; a temporary drag handle appears while moving the HUD.
比赛时间轴 · 日期选择器使用比赛时区: Contest timeline · Date pickers use event time zone
没有找到 teams、data 或 standings 数组: Could not find teams, data or standings array
注意：关闭「点击穿透状态」只隐藏 HUD 上的文字，不会关闭真正的点击穿透功能；: Note: Hiding “Click-through status” only hides the HUD label; it does not disable click-through itself. Change the actual setting here or in the menu bar.
积分 Δ = 本次成功读取的总分 − 上次成功读取的总分；全场 / 组别排名 Δ: Score Δ = current successful score − previous successful score; overall / division rank Δ = previous rank − current rank. ↑ means rank improved, ↓ means rank worsened. The first successful fetch has no Δ.
纯净模式只保留两个倒计时及目标时间；排行榜的全场排名、组别排名、积分，和最近提交: Clean mode shows only the two countdowns and target times, plus leaderboard metrics and recent submissions when real data exists.
请输入有效端点（远程须 HTTPS；本机可使用 HTTP）: Enter a valid endpoint (HTTPS remote; HTTP loopback only)
调整位置 · 点击穿透暂时关闭 · 拖动此处: Move HUD · Click-through temporarily disabled · Drag here
进入最后阶段后隐藏「下一阶段」整栏，只保留比赛结束倒计时: In the final phase, hide the entire Next Phase column and show only the event-end countdown
透明度 0% = 完全不透明；100% = 完全透明。背景与文字独立调节，不再降: 0% transparency = fully opaque; 100% = fully transparent. Background and text are adjusted separately.
配置：~/Library/Application Support/CTFHUD/: Configuration: ~/Library/Application Support/CTFHUD/config.json; window preferences are stored in macOS UserDefaults.
